data.name: Elira
data.gender_notes: Elira is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Elira was a nymph who personified the light of the moon. In Christianity, Elira is derived from the Greek word 'elos' meaning 'light'. The name is reminiscent of the light of Christ, which shines in the darkness. The name Elira carries the meaning “Light, Shining” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Elira usually hope their child will grow to embody light, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and hope in times of darkness.
data.etymology: Elira belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elira total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Elira responded by offering her own body as a sacrifice to Christ instead, and was subsequently executed.
